# Kome.Digest known-answer vectors. tests/test_digest.adb reads them.
# DESIGN.md §8: acc(e) = BLAKE2b-256("kome/acc" || h || i) for i in 0..15,
# concatenated (i = 0 first) and read as a 512-byte little-endian integer.
# fp(R) = BLAKE2b-256("kome/fp" || |R| as u64 big-endian || ACC(R) as 512
# bytes little-endian), and ACC(R) = sum of acc(e) mod 2^4096. i is one
# byte. Python computed these values, independently of monocypher and of
# the SPARK code:
#   b2 = lambda x: hashlib.blake2b(x, digest_size=32).digest()
#   acc = lambda h: b''.join(b2(b'kome/acc' + h + bytes([i])) for i in range(16))
#   fp = lambda hs: b2(b'kome/fp' + len(hs).to_bytes(8, 'big') +
#        (sum(int.from_bytes(acc(h), 'little') for h in hs) % 2**4096).to_bytes(512, 'little'))
# Formats:
#   acc <h, 32-byte hex> <acc(h), 512-byte hex, wire order>
#   fp  <n> <h1 .. hn concatenated, hex, or - when n = 0> <fp, hex>
